reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the box, which is a nice touch, but $1 a day for two big capsules is more than I pay for magnesium now. I would wait to see if it goes on a flash sale or gets a coupon.
objection: $29.99 for 30 days is about $1 a day, and I can get a bottle of magnesium glycinate for much less per day. Two size 00 capsules at night are big to swallow, and I have no proof yet that this brand is worth the extra money.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings the box to about $19.99 or less, or a cheaper first-box trial offer.
